channel.title: GiveOwl – Black Friday contests 2026 (Canada)
channel.description: Contests and giveaways open to residents of Canada that are tied to Black Friday (Friday, November 27, 2026) and Cyber Monday (November 30, 2026), each checked on the organizer's own page. Many close within days of Black Friday, so check the closing date on each one. Only entries we have confirmed as open are listed. Below them are other open contests that are not tied to Black Friday.

item.title: iCash Black Friday Watch & Win: 3 × $100 e-gift cards – iCash (Finabanx Ltd.)
item.description: Prize: 3 × $100 e-gift card (Best Buy, President’s Choice or Homesense/Winners). Deadline: November 11, 2026. Submit the free online entry form at contest.icash.ca. No purchase necessary. Canadian residents of the age of majority, excluding QC, SK and NL; skill-testing question. Nov 4 9:00 am ET – Nov 11, 2026 11:59 pm ET; draw on or about Nov 12

item.title: La Petite Ourse Black Friday giveaway: 10 ÉVOLUTION cloth diapers – La Petite Ourse
item.description: Prize: 10 ÉVOLUTION cloth diapers (value $149.90). Deadline: November 11, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the La Petite Ourse giveaway page (or email info@lapetiteourse.ca). Social shares are optional bonus entries. Canadian residents of the age of majority; skill-testing question. Nov 5–11, 2026

item.title: Genuine Tea Early Access Black Friday Giveaway: 5 × $100 gift cards – Genuine Tea Co.
item.description: Prize: Five Genuine Tea e-gift cards of CA$100 each (total CA$500). Deadline: November 14, 2026. Join the Genuine Tea Black Friday Early Access list (free, no purchase). One entry per person. Canadian residents of the age of majority; skill-testing question. Oct 15 – Nov 14, 2026, 11:59 PM ET; draw about Dec 3

item.title: ACON Black Friday 2026 "Ultimate Backyard Setup" Giveaway (Canada) – ACON
item.description: Prize: ACON X 17ft trampoline + Soccer Goal Panel + Basketball Hoop with Back Net (worth CA$6,477). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Sign up with your email on ACON's Canadian Black Friday page (joins the ACON VIP newsletter). Free. Ends Nov 30, 2026, 1:00 AM EST

item.title: Apollo Scooters Black Friday Weekly Draw (CA) – Apollo Imports Inc. (Apollo Scooters)
item.description: Prize: An Apollo Go electric scooter (ARV CA$999) for a free-entry winner; one winner per weekly draw, 7 in total. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entry: submit the form on the Black Friday early access page (marketing emails optional). One entry for the whole promotion. Canadian residents of the age of majority. Ends Nov 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET
